changed.title: A fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuit for the unrestricted shared-key witness moment at any order and fixed schedule
changed.statement:
∀ (k r h t : ℕ), 0 < h → h ≤ k → 0 < t →
  let rot := fun (d x : ℕ) => ((x <<< (d % k)) ||| (x >>> (k-d % k))) % 2^k
  let chi := fun (x : ℕ) => (List.range k).foldl (fun (acc i : ℕ) =>
    acc ||| ((xor (x.testBit i) (!(x.testBit ((i+1) % k)) && x.testBit ((i+2) % k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let run := fun (masks : ℕ → Fin (2^k)) (col : Bool) (key name : ℕ) =>
    let gap : ℕ := if col then 2 else 1
    (List.range r).foldl (fun z j =>
      let mixed := z ^^^ rot gap z ^^^ rot (k-gap % k) z
      chi mixed ^^^ rot (if col then 3*(j+1)+1 else 2*j) key ^^^
        (masks (if col then r+j else j)).val) (rot (if col then 3 else 1) key ^^^ name)
  let B := if r = 0 then 2 else if r = 1 then 7 else 7*r-2
  let seam := fun (b : ℕ) => min k (h+b-k)
  let A := 2^(B+seam B+1)
  let scan := 2^(10*r+seam (4*r)+seam (6*r)+2) * Nat.choose (t+A-1) t
  let wiresIn := 2*r*k+2*h
  let bits := fun (len word : ℕ) => (List.range len).map (fun i => word.testBit i)
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (out : Fin ((t+2)*k+1) → Fin (wiresIn+C.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack wiresIn C ∧
    C.output < wiresIn+C.size ∧
    C.size ≤ 1048576*((k+1)*(r+1)*(t+2))^4 * min (2^(3*k)) scan ∧
    ∀ (masks : ℕ → Fin (2^k)) (a b : Fin (2^h)),
      let input := (List.range (2*r)).flatMap (fun j => bits k (masks j).val) ++
        bits h a.val ++ bits h b.val
      let num := fun (x y : Fin (2^k)) => (Finset.univ.filter (fun key : Fin (2^k) =>
        (run masks false key.val x.val >>> (k-h)) = a.val ∧
        (run masks true key.val y.val >>> (k-h)) = b.val)).card
      let moment := ∑ x : Fin (2^k), ∑ y : Fin (2^k), (num x y)^t
      ∀ j : Fin ((t+2)*k+1), (C.wires input).getD (out j).val false = moment.testBit j.val

changed.title: Separated even-lane query kernels outperform consecutive pins exactly three through eight questions short of recovery
changed.statement:
∀ (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t) (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → j+3 ≤ t →
  let h := 3*t-2-j
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  let ix := fun j : ℕ => (⟨j % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.zero_lt_succ 5) ht)⟩ : Fin n)
  let rot := fun (s : ℕ) (w : W) (i : Fin n) => w (ix (i.val + n - s % n))
  let out := fun (name c raw : W) (i : Fin n) =>
    let old := rot 3 raw + name
    let y := fun j : Fin n => old j + old (ix (j.val+2)) + old (ix (j.val+n-2))
    y i + (1+y (ix (i.val+1)))*y (ix (i.val+2)) + rot 4 raw i + c i
  let mix := fun (w : W) (i : Fin n) =>
    let old := rot 3 w
    old i + old (ix (i.val+2)) + old (ix (i.val+n-2))
  let a := 3*t
  let evenBit := fun (w : W) (i : Fin a) => mix w (ix (2*i.val))
  let next := fun (i : Fin a) => (⟨(i.val+1) % a, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.succ_pos 2) ht)⟩ : Fin a)
  ∀ name c : W,
    let win := fun (spaced : Bool) (k : ℕ) =>
      ∃ (v : Fin h → Fin a → F) (A : ℕ → W →ₗ[F] W) (b : ℕ → W),
        let q := fun (i : Fin h) (w : W) => ∑ s, v i s * evenBit w s
        let live := fun (s : Fin a) => ∃ w : W, (∀ i, q i w = 0) ∧ evenBit w s ≠ 0
        let run := fun w : W =>
          (List.finRange h).foldl (fun u i => 2*u + (if q i w = 0 then 0 else 1)) (0 : ℕ)
        (spaced = true → ∀ s, ¬ (live s ∧ live (next s))) ∧
        (spaced = false → ∀ i w, q i w = mix w (ix (2*i.val))) ∧
        k ≤ Nat.card {w : W // out name c w = A (run w) w + b (run w)}
    (∀ k, win true k ↔ 8^(j+1)*k ≤ (5^(j+1)+3^(j+1))*2^n) ∧
      ((∃ k, win true k ∧ ¬ win false k) ↔ 3 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ 8) ∧
      ((∃ k, win false k ∧ ¬ win true k) ↔ 9 ≤ j)

changed.statement:
∀ (k r d K : ℕ), 0 < k → d ≤ r →
  let rot := fun (s word : Nat) =>
    ((word <<< (s % k)) ||| (word >>> (k - s % k))) % 2 ^ k
  let step := fun (word : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i =>
      acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit i)
        (!(word.testBit ((i + 1) % k)) && word.testBit ((i + 2) % k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let constant := fun (j : Nat) => 3 ^ (k + j) % 2 ^ k
  let first := fun (t rowKey rowName : Nat) =>
    (List.range t).foldl (fun rowState rowIndex =>
      step (rowState ^^^ rot 1 rowState ^^^ rot (k - 1) rowState) ^^^
        rot (2 * rowIndex) rowKey ^^^ constant (rowIndex + 1)) (rot 1 rowKey ^^^ rowName)
  let second := fun (t colKey colName : Nat) =>
    (List.range t).foldl (fun colState colIndex =>
      step (colState ^^^ rot 2 colState ^^^ rot (k - 2) colState) ^^^
        rot (3 * (colIndex + 1) + 1) colKey ^^^ constant (r + (colIndex + 1)))
      (rot 3 colKey ^^^ colName)
  let V := Fin 7 × Fin k
  let P := V × Bool
  let keyLog := Nat.clog 2 (K+1)
  let B := 7*d+3
  let budget := 1048576*(k+1)^2*(K+1)^2*((k+1)*4^B+(r+1)+(keyLog+1)^2)
  let rounds := 128*(k+r+B+(keyLog+1)^2+1)
  let source := fun (a : P → Bool) =>
    [false,true] ++ List.ofFn (fun j : Fin (Fintype.card P) => a ((Fintype.equivFin P).symm j))
  let Gate := Bool × ℕ × ℕ
  let run := fun (G : List Gate) (a : P → Bool) =>
    G.foldl (fun (w : List Bool) g =>
      let l := w.getD g.2.1 false
      let r := w.getD g.2.2 false
      w ++ [if g.1 then l && r else l || r]) (source a)
  let N := 2 + Fintype.card P

let header := fun z : Nat => List.replicate z true ++ [false]

  ((List.finRange n).filter (fun j => decide (i < j))).map (fun j => (i,j)))

  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) g,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)
∃ solve : List Bool → List Bool, fast solve ∧
∀ (k : Nat) (crown : Bool), 2 ≤ k → (crown = true → 7 ≤ k) →
  let nr := if crown then k+2 else k
  let nc := if crown then k+1 else k
  let A := fun (i : Fin nr) (j : Fin nc) => if crown then
    decide (i.val ≠ k+1 ∧ ¬ (i.val < k ∧ i.val = j.val)) else decide (i.val = j.val)
  let Fn := (Fin nr → Bool) → (Fin nc → Bool) → Bool
  let eligible := fun f : Fn => ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    (if crown then PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 2*k+1 else PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*k) ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents A C ∧ ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)
  ∀ (hard : List ((Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool)))
    (soft : List (((Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool)) × Bool)),
  let fits := fun f : Fn => eligible f ∧ ∀ h ∈ hard, f h.1 h.2 = crown
  let score := fun f : Fn => (soft.filter (fun t => decide (f t.1.1 t.1.2 = t.2))).length

    f (fun i => decide (i.val = e.1.val ∨ i.val = e.2.val)) (fun _ => false) = !crown)
  let vs := (pairs k).toFinset
  ∀ tree : List (List Bool × (Fin k × Fin k)),
  let keys := tree.map Prod.fst
  keys.Nodup → (∀ a e, (a,e) ∈ tree → e ∈ vs) →
  (∀ a bit, a ++ [bit] ∈ keys → a ∈ keys) →
  let atNode := fun (a : List Bool) => (tree.find? (fun r => decide (r.1 = a))).map Prod.snd
  let route := fun f : Fn => (List.range tree.length).foldl (fun a _ =>
    (atNode a).elim a (fun e => a ++ [decide (e ∈ probe f)])) ([] : List Bool)
  let good := ∀ a : List Bool, ∃ (b : Int) (w : Fin k × Fin k → Int), ∀ f : Fn,
    fits f → route f = a → (score f : Int) = b + (probe f).sum w
  let mask := fun S : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) => (pairs k).map (fun e => decide (e ∈ S))
  let banks := fun z : (Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool) => List.ofFn z.1 ++ List.ofFn z.2

    tree.flatMap (fun t => header t.1.length ++ t.1 ++ header t.2.1.val ++ header t.2.2.val)
  let bits := fun z : Nat => (List.range (soft.length.log2+1)).map (fun j => z.testBit j)
  (good → ∃ slot : Fin (k/2+1) → List Bool,
    solve x = [true] ++ (List.finRange (k/2+1)).flatMap slot ∧
    ∀ s, let present := ∃ f : Fn, fits f ∧ (probe f).card = s.val

    Disjoint P T ∧ 2 ≤ T.card ∧

    (soft.filter (fun t => t.2 && decide (lists S t))).length =

  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
  let obs := fun (f : Fn) (R T : Finset (Fin n)) =>
    f (fun i => decide (i ∈ R)) (fun j => decide (j ∈ T))

    ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
    ∀ z ∈ hard, obs f z.1 z.2 = false

  ∃ (k : Nat) (G R : Fin k → Fin k → Bool), write input = paint k G R ∧
    let out := fun P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k) => decode (input ++
      (List.finRange k).flatMap (fun i => bits (k.log2+1) (P i).val))
    let red := fun P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k) => ((pairs k).filter
      (fun e => decide (P e.1 = e.2) && R e.1 e.2)).length
    (∀ P, perfect k G P → ∃ f : Fn, valid f ∧ out P = code f ∧ red P = (m+1)*size f+score f) ∧
    (∀ f : Fn, valid f → ∃! P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), perfect k G P ∧ out P = code f) ∧
    ∀ s j : Nat, s ≤ n/2 → j ≤ m →
      Nat.card {P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k) // perfect k G P ∧ red P = (m+1)*s+j} =

    let reds := ((pairs v).filter (fun e => G e.1 e.2 && R e.1 e.2)).map (fun e => (e.1.val,e.2.val))

      (fun i => decide (i = e.1 ∨ i = e.2))
    let zero := List.replicate n false

    let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
